result.question: Why were the descendants of Dan looking for territory?

readings.answer: Because they had not yet received an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
readings.support: For up to that time they had not come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

assessments.reason: Directly matches the clause “For up to that time they had not come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel,” which answers the reason why they were looking for territory.
The text says they were “looking for territory to occupy,” which states their purpose; “why” can reasonably be taken as purpose here, though it is a different fact from the key’s cause.

result.reason: The passage gives both a cause (no inheritance) and a purpose (to occupy it), and the wording ‘why’ can fit either.
